parent_objective: execute no-training challenge-family benchmark for raw scaling candidates
blocked_by: raw candidates have m121-style fresh margin evidence but no robust challenge-family evidence

public_gates: near-threshold robust challenge benchmark with 128 episodes
late high-energy robust challenge benchmark with 128 episodes
include M568, alpha_0_1 candidates, raw candidates, heuristic, and random
success/termination non-regression versus M568 on each family
raw clearance nonnegative on each family and combined clearance >= +0.001
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train actor or residual parameters
do not change thresholds after seeing challenge results
do not treat these public challenge configs as private holdouts

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_generalization: challenge-family check for raw scaling margin signal
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: executes second scenario-family benchmark after M900 margin-only fresh pass
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: fresh public challenge diagnostic only; no training, PPO, public-base integration, private holdout claim, or promotion
stop_condition: stop if either challenge benchmark cannot sample scenarios
stop if raw success or termination regresses beyond tolerance
stop if raw clearance turns negative on either challenge family
stop if PPO or promotion is attempted
fallback_plan: if sampling fails, route to challenge config sampling audit
if behavior regresses, route to behavior-regression audit
if margin signal fails, route to raw scaling generalization failure audit
if margin signal passes, route to branch synthesis before integration design

hypothesis: Raw candidates will preserve success/termination and retain positive margin movement on robust challenge scenario families.
success_criteria: M903 keeps PPO and promotion blocked
failure_criteria: raw candidates regress success or termination beyond tolerance
raw clearance is negative on either family
